name: wicked-selftest
description: The wicked product self-test: installs a set of wicked artifacts (published, or packed from checkouts) into a hermetic temp root, boots an ephemeral daemon with stub seats, runs a fixed, versioned suite against its wire, and tears everything down. Grown from wicked-smoke (S01-S11); `wicked-smoke` stays as an alias.

scripts.check: node --check bin/wicked-smoke.mjs && node --check bin/wicked-selftest.mjs && node --check lib/main.mjs && node lib/selfcheck.mjs && node lib/pack-selfcheck.mjs
